answer: Concretely, the economy can measure round-trip latency on a two-stage stale-proof challenge. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The terrace of work and the orchard of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a juniper to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
